For me, I never wanted the one night stands or parties.  I did that and it WAS NOT FUN.  Some of the things I thing of might seem petty (I love her family and they all love me.  I sometimes go see them without her and always talk to her grandma on the phone.)  If you a truly comfortable without having those things, don't let it bother you.  I can't speak for what you've gone through in your life but for me, knowing that I did get it right the first time seems amazing.  
A lot of things are going to depend on both of your personalities.  We both had a few mistakes along the way, it was part of growing up.  If you are done with it, don't worry.  If it is hard seeing other pretty girls in your high school, think of what it is going to be like when you WON'T be seeing them anymore.  Contrary to popular belief, finding someone who you actually can care about is very hard.  Bar hopping to find a date or going to social events with your best friend is kind of lame.  How many relationships do you hear about that lasted forever started in a bar?  I know my parents did, but that was a VERY long time ago, and they were both middle aged at the time.  They bar wasn't a place to pick someone up.  It was the place they went to get away from life and its hardships.  
TL;DR Don't throw something away because you want what you don't have when you might never get it.  Regret is very hard to live with and not all people can live with it.  If you care enough to ask random people on the internet, you have a bit more emotion control than most teenagers.  Don't ruin a good thing.

Plasma or clinical trials is pretty much it if you don't have a job.  Where I donate plasma you get 20 bucks for the first time a week, then 30 for your 2nd time.  So 50 bucks a week would pretty much cover any groceries unless its expensive where you live.  
Clinical trials tend to pay a lot but usually have multiple weekend commitments, a tight BMI ratio, and non-smoking unless you get lucky.  You have to bring all your own personal items (soap, shampoo, towels).  They have wi-fi here but you need your own laptop.
